Bidders can also submit the EMD with Banker’s Cheque in favour of IREL (India) Limited payable at chavara . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the BC along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 5. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Payment online through RTGS / internet banking in Beneficiary name IREL (India) Limited Account No. 57013595003 IFSC Code sbin0070055 Bank Name State bank of India Branch address chavara . Bidder to indicate bid number and name of bidding entity in the transaction details field at the time of on- line transfer. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the Online Payment Transfer along with bid. 6. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of IREL (India) Limited payable at chavara . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 7. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses : 1(A). Technical Criteria: i) The party shall be a manufacturer or authorized Dealer / Stockiest of steel items. Manufacturer should s ubmit Udyam certificate towards proof of manufacturer of basic steel metal & authorized Dealer / Stockies t should submit dealership / stockiest certificate from the manufacturer. ii) The material shall conforms to IS 2062 and the same shall be supplied without twist or bend. The bidder should submit self-declaration towards the same. iii) The bidder shall submit copies of the purchase order for supply of Structural Steel materials to any Cent ral / State Govt. / Public Sector Undertaking / Private organisation during last 7 years from the date of tend er. Documentary evidence towards supply executed viz.Copies of purchase order and invoice or document towards acceptance of the item should be enclosed. 1(B).Certification: The bidder Shall submit a valid Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) license/certificate autho rizing the use of the ISI mark for the specific quoted product(s). The certificate must be valid on the date of tender opening and remain valid during the entire execution/supply period of the contract. Bids from unaut horised dealers or products lacking valid BIS/ISI certification will be summarily rejected.

Note: The Bids satisfying both Technical 1(A) & 1(B) only will be considered for further processing. Note: All specifications, terms and conditions mentioned in the "Buyer Specification Document" are applica ble to this bid .
